Every from string occurs exactly once in its file (checked with C:\Temp\octapm-cert\scratch\checkmut.js before the run).

QK2 the keys revoked are those acting as the person, not those the person created

mutations.from: await require("./auth.service").endIdentitySessions(tx, userId, now, { reason: "identity_closed", actorId: actor?.id || null });
mutations.to: await tx.refreshSession.updateMany({ where: { userId, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: now } }); await tx.ssoTicket.updateMany({ where: { userId, usedAt: null }, data: { usedAt: now } });

mutations.to: await tx.refreshSession.updateMany({ where: { userId: existingUser.id, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: now } }); await tx.ssoTicket.updateMany({ where: { userId: existingUser.id, usedAt: null }, data: { usedAt: now } });
